speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Morning. Nothing. We just pulled an all-nighter trying to fix a zero-gravity... pasta maker. I'm gonna make a coffee run. Do you want any?

speaker: penny
text: Morning. What's up?

speaker: penny
text: Oh, no, thanks. I have coffee.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Great. So how'd it go with Stuart last night?

speaker: penny
text: I really don't want to talk about it.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Yeah. Right. Sure. The thing is, before you guys went out, I spoke to him and...

speaker: penny
text: I said I don't want to talk about it.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay... I just... I kind of...

speaker: penny
text: Look, Leonard, what goes on between me and Stuart is none of your business. So just leave it alone, okay?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: If you really want to clean up your karma, go get my freakin' latte.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Hang on, I think I've got this. Help me see if we can wedge this little piece of PVC behind the support rod.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're overestimating the tensile strength of the substructure you're building.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Sheldon, I know what I'm doing.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: If you knew what you were doing, there wouldn't be a space toilet where my coffee table should be.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Howard, wait. Why don't you use this instead of the PVC to keep the transverse filter assembly in place?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Because this is not a spare part from the space station. This is the thing from the pizza box that keeps the lid from touching the cheese.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: That what that's for? In India, the lid just touches the cheese. Of course, we also have rampant poverty and periodic outbreaks of cholera, so a little cardboard in our cheese is no biggie.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Where are you going?

text: Comic book store.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, an excellent idea! I could certainly use a break.

text: Me, too.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Hold on, you can go to the comic book store when man can once again safely poop in space.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Why does Leonard get to go?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Cause he's upset over his situation with Penny and if I have to hear about it again, I'm going to kick him in his ovaries. Thanks for understanding, Howard.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I got your back, sister. All right, I think we've got a prototype ready to test. Hand me that Tupperware.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Wow, that's heavy.

text: Damn right it's heavy, it's my mother's meat loaf, it's been testing toilets for generations.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I must say, Howard, I think a detailed letter to MIT describing your current circumstances might entitle you to a refund on your master's degree.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Okay, simulated zero-gravity human waste disposal test with meat loaf analog in three, two, one.
